title: Product seller must exercise reasonable care
description: Product seller must exercise reasonable care in assembling, inspecting or maintaining a product

content.what: must exercise reasonable care in assembling, inspecting or maintaining a product
conditions: such failure was the proximate cause of the harm
limitations: if the product seller can prove that he did not fail to exercise reasonable care in assembling, inspecting or maintaining such product and did pass on the warnings or instructions of the product manufacturer regarding the dangers involved or proper usage of the product while selling such product
